action.user_hint: Choose a photo to get started.

items.title: Anime reaction GIF
items.prompt_text: Create a seamless looping GIF of the uploaded subjects in 90s anime style: expressive eyes, simplified facial shapes, flat cel-shading, soft colors. Begin fully stylized, already reacting. Smoothly intensify a wildly exaggerated peak emotion, allowing expression-specific facial distortion and playful visual effects. Then soften slightly back to the starting pose, never neutral, forming a seamless loop. Ease into the peak and recovery. Keep identity, line-work, and framing consistent. No photorealism. First ask, “How do you want to react?” and offer emoji choices.
items.image_alt: An orange-haired anime character in a blue shirt clasps their hands under their chin, with pink heart-shaped eyes, floating hearts, and sparkles.

items.title: ’80s flashback
items.prompt_text: Using my uploaded photo, show me what I would have looked like around 1985. Preserve my identity, facial features, skin tone, age, and recognizable appearance.  Reimagine my hair, clothing, accessories, and surroundings with bold, unmistakably mid-1980s styling—expressive silhouettes, statement accessories, layered details, distinctive colors, and textures. Make it feel like a genuine 1985 photograph with analog grain, faded color, direct flash, and subtle softness. Add a period-accurate 1980s red-orange date stamp in the lower corner. No recognizable posters. No modern objects or text.
prompt_hints: Photo of a person in the foreground, full body
items.image_alt: A smiling woman in black sunglasses, bright pink hoop earrings, a pink mesh top, and an oversized denim jacket poses in front of indoor plants. A red-orange date stamp reads “85 7 21” in the lower-right corner.

items.title: Caricature
items.prompt_text: Create a caricature of me based off what you know about me and my interests. Make it whimsical and exaggerated, with oversized facial features, bold lines, humorous expressions, a loose cartoon-like look and minimal text.
prompt_hints: Photo of a person as the foreground
items.image_alt: A smiling illustrated woman with a headlamp carries books, a stethoscope, and paint supplies against a blue sky.

items.title: Anime
items.prompt_text: Create a trending anime art style image from the uploaded subject. Use confident line-work with slight variation and minimal cel shading using flat shadow shapes. Use bright, saturated colors and clean graphic lighting. The style is defined by exaggerated, cartoonish character proportions featuring highly expressive, simplistic facial features that allow for immense emotional range, with highly varied stretched anatomy. Transform the environment into a slightly warped space with playful perspective distortion and simplified objects. Composition and tone should be energetic, lively, and comedic in a fully stylized, non-realistic world.
prompt_hints: Photo of a person making an expressive face or in a unique situation

items.title: Pin collection
items.prompt_text: Based on what you know about me and my interests, create a set of 8 hyper real illustrated enamel pins in a 4x5 image. 1 medium pin is a portrait of me, 1 small pin is a word that describes me, 1 small pin is my name. The style is bold, flat, bright colors, eye catching. If you don’t know enough about me yet, pull cues from the photo.
prompt_hints: Photo of a person in the foreground with personal details in the background, or while participating in a hobby

items.title: Underwater
items.prompt_text: Create an extreme close-up underwater portrait after the subject has just jumped into a swimming pool or clear shallow water. Keep the mood calm, weightless, and ethereal, emphasizing light reflections. No struggle or urgency.
prompt_hints: Headshot of a person

items.title: 3D avatar
items.prompt_text: Create a premium glossy 3D "designer toy" render of the subject(s) using the uploaded image as the only reference. Render one floating head per person (no duplication), cropped cleanly below the jaw with a visible neck and full head comfortably framed. Style: high-quality vinyl figure with ultra-smooth, simplified forms, rounded volumes, and strong glossy reflections across key facial areas. Hair should be sculpted, glossy, and stylized, with embedded playful accessories. Include oversized retro wraparound sunglasses with vibrant, matching frame/lens colors. Use strong studio lighting with pronounced highlights. Background: blue sky with soft clouds.
prompt_hints: Headshot of a person

items.title: Tarot card
items.prompt_text: Create a tarot card based off of what you know about me in the classic Rider-Waite style. Style me in a hand-drawn figure using bold but imperfect black ink linework with wobble and variation, flat colors with no shading. Layer subtle tarot visual elements around the figure. Add paper texture and print feel.
prompt_hints: Portrait photo of a person

items.title: Statue
items.prompt_text: Create a detailed neoclassical Greek white Carrara marble statue honoring the uploaded image. If the image has a person, depict the person in the statue as a powerful allegorical figure in motion, with flowing garments, a confident pose, and a serious expression. If it is not a person, do not add a person. Include elements from the photo to give the statue personality and non-generic historical artifacts based on what you know about me. Set in a museum hall. Photorealistic with medium depth of field, natural perspective, and warm museum lighting casting dramatic, realistic shadows.
prompt_hints: Photo of a person or pet in the foreground

items.title: 16-bit arcade
items.prompt_text: Transform the uploaded subject and environment into a Retro 16-Bit Arcade Fighting Game Pixel Art. Preserve identity while redesigning wardrobe into bold, readable arcade-character shapes. Name the character 'Player 1" and pose the subject as a full body character with exaggerated expressions. Avoid modern vector pixel polish. Rebuild the environment as a detailed side-view fighting-game stage with layered pixel scenery, dramatic lighting, and period-appropriate arcade interface elements.
prompt_hints: Detailed, expressive photo with a full body view of a person in the foreground as the main subject
items.image_alt: A pixel-art fighter in a red jacket and blue trousers poses on a neon-lit 16-bit arcade stage.

items.title: Handwritten style
items.prompt_text: Add a hand drawn overlay on top of the image. Final output should be stylish, relaxed and effortlessly casual. Drawing rules: Use thin, hand-drawn lines as if drawn with a white pen. Keep it in a single-stroke style: rough and slightly uneven. Add outlines tracing around the outer edges of objects. Use arrows or dotted lines to guide the viewer’s eye. Text rules: Handwritten text. Keep it short, like a casual inner monologue. Tone: diary-like, brief, and emotion-focused. Commentary should be positive and sweet. Decorations: Add steam, sparkles, hearts, small emoticon-like faces sparingly. Avoid overdoing it; leave some “negative space”.
prompt_hints: Photo of person with their friends, family, or children

items.title: Makeup guide
items.prompt_text: Create a high-quality “Makeup Analysis Guide” infographic based on the portrait photo I uploaded. Make it feel professional and clean, like a modern beauty-magazine feature. Use the uploaded photo as the foundation, preserving the person’s real facial features and recognizability without excessive retouching. Prioritize visuals that highlight the key points, with minimal text and no long paragraphs. Use a 9:16 aspect ratio.
prompt_hints: Headshot of a person

items.title: Scribble
items.prompt_text: Redraw the attached image in the most clumsy, scribbly, and utterly pathetic way possible. Use a white background, and make it look like it was drawn in an old computer painting program with a mouse. It should be vaguely similar but also not really, kind of matching but also off in a confusing, awkward way, with that low-quality pixel-by-pixel feel that really emphasizes how ridiculously bad it is. Actually, you know what, whatever, just draw it however you want.
prompt_hints: Interesting, expressive photo of people or pets

items.title: Your bobblehead
items.prompt_text: Create a studio photograph of a cheap mass-produced plastic bobblehead toy inspired by the uploaded photo. Reference the person’s identity and exact face, but make the face more youthful with a broad friendly smile and chunky molded plastic hair. The toy must look physically photographed, not CGI or a 3D render. Oversized bobblehead head, comically huge, about 12x the tiny body. Simplified molded vinyl face with painted eyes, painted brows, molded smile, visible paint boundaries, tiny paint misalignment, subtle mold seam lines, injection-molded plastic texture, small scuffs, soft specular highlights. Molded plastic hair with chunky sculpted grooves, not individual strands. Environment inspired by the photo.
prompt_hints: Photo with a person as main subject
items.image_alt: A smiling plastic bobblehead with pink curly hair and a striped shirt stands on a black base on a city street.

items.title: Mini me
items.prompt_text: Turn this photo into a magical “Mini Me” world where tiny animated versions of yourself come to life around you. These cute 3D-style mini characters interact with your everyday surroundings — climbing onto your shoulders, sitting on your bag, waving, playing, and copying your poses — creating a playful yet emotional social media story-worthy scene full of personality and story. The original photo remains untouched while the tiny characters bring the image to life with depth, movement, realistic shadows, and a soft aesthetic vibe.
prompt_hints: Photo with a person as main subject

items.title: Cross-section
items.prompt_text: Transform the main subject of the uploaded image into a clean educational cutaway diagram on a white background. Keep the subject’s distinctive features from the original image, show a believable cross-section or layered interior, and add clear labeled callouts. Make it look like a textbook or museum science graphic, with clarity and accuracy prioritized over dramatic or artistic styling.
prompt_hints: Piece of technology

items.title: Enhance photos
items.prompt_text: Improve the quality of my photo and make it clearer.
prompt_hints: Vintage photo, from decades ago, grainy, low resolution

items.title: Wanderlust
items.prompt_text: Use this image to create a travel collage by placing the main subject of the original image in a travel destination location with location appropriate styling as an instant photo with instant photo style lighting, color and quality. Include a postcard from a random less traveled destination in blue ink pen inspiring me to travel to new places. It should feel intimate, personal, and cleanly curated. Add souvenirs and small details that create a sense of a memento in a balanced layout with natural lighting.

items.title: Nighttime flash
items.prompt_text: Transform the photo into nighttime chic flash photography. Use harsh direct on-camera flash with strong highlights, deep shadows, and slight overexposure on the subject. Set the scene at night with a dark, moody background while keeping realistic colors and textures. Add a candid, editorial feel, slightly imperfect framing, motion energy, and spontaneous expression. Emphasize high contrast, glossy skin highlights, and subtle film grain for a raw, fashion-nightlife aesthetic.
prompt_hints: Photo of a person
Photo of a pet

items.title: Blueprint poster
items.prompt_text: Create a single-subject blueprint poster using only the main subject from the uploaded image. Render it as a clean white technical line drawing on a deep cobalt-blue blueprint background with a subtle grid. Use flat 2D schematic linework, orthographic contours, construction lines, measurement ticks, arrows, and minimal technical labels. The composition may also include 2-3 smaller inset studies or alternate views. Keep the layout simple and balanced with no shading, no 3D, no lighting, no extra objects.
prompt_hints: Everyday household items or foods

items.title: Color analysis
items.prompt_text: Create a personal color analysis graphic using this portrait. Show side-by-side clothing color comparisons to highlight which colors suit the subject best. Make it visual-first, with short labels only and no paragraphs.

items.title: Comic
items.prompt_text: Create a comic strip using the subject from the uploaded image. Style the comic strip in a bold Sunday funnies style with thick outlines, halftone textures, and bright 1980s colors. Pick one clear, exaggerated visual element from the photo and build the story around it, leading to a funny or unexpected payoff. Keep the dialogue short, natural, and easy to read, and make sure the joke lands clearly at a glance with no randomness or confusion.
prompt_hints: Full body photo of a person engaged in an activity
Pet picture with a funny face

items.title: Anime comic
items.prompt_text: Create a wholly original, simple black-and-white comic strip in a retro hand-inked manga style. Use 2-3 horizontal panels. Treat the uploaded image as the character reference; redraw the character entirely in manga form with consistent line work and shading across every panel. Interpret the person as the main character and, based on their appearance, generate an uplifting encounter with a clear “setup-reinforce-turnaround” structure: the first panel establishes context, the second develops the situation, and the third delivers a surprise twist. Keep the dialogue short, natural, and upbeat. No technology.
prompt_hints: Full body photo of a person with a friend, pet, or at an interesting location

items.title: Fantasy newspaper
items.prompt_text: Transform the person in the uploaded photo into a whimsical black-and-white vintage newspaper front page. Place them as the main portrait in the center, styled like an old engraved photograph. Surround them with bold, exaggerated headline text, narrow newspaper columns, and playful subheadings. Use high-contrast black ink on pure white background, subtle paper texture, and classic serif fonts. Add quirky, magical or humorous headlines to create a charming, slightly surreal tone. Keep the layout dense, editorial, and reminiscent of an old fantasy newspaper. Ensure the subject's face remains recognizable but stylized to match the printed newspaper aesthetic.
prompt_hints: Full body photo of a person

items.title: Film strip
items.prompt_text: Transform the uploaded image into cinematic 3-frame sequential film stills (horizontal frames stacked vertically), full bleed edge-to-edge. Each frame should show a different moment from the same scene, with clear progression. Vary the composition, camera angle, and distances to create a sense of movement and storytelling. Use a cinematic, cooler-toned, high-contrast, deep-space blacks film with a natural color grade. Add subtle film grain, slight motion blur, and natural imperfections to emulate analog photography. Keep the composition candid and emotionally grounded, with a sense of movement and quiet storytelling. Overall aesthetic: cinematic, nostalgic, and organic, like raw film stills.
